rules.name: Always Block Requires Timing Control
rules.description: An 'always' block without an event control (@) and without a delay control (#) is legal IEEE 1364 but has no meaning as RTL: it maps to no hardware and, in simulation, it forms a zero-delay infinite loop that never advances time.

rules.name: No Simulation-Only Always in RTL
rules.description: A delay-controlled 'always' (e.g. a clock generator) is a simulation construct: it is not synthesizable and belongs in a testbench, not in RTL. Testbench files are exempt via testbench detection.
